aggregation: max float32 chunk cosine per skill, deduplicated top50

bootstrap.unit: question cluster paired across encoders and repeated sizes

configs.B_matched: exact Qwen full-text source-character spans, with explicitly recorded overlength subdivisions only if required
configs.C_native8k: complete full text; native BGE tokenizer chunks at tested context

experiment: BGE-M3 LoRA on pinned SkillRet training split
official_inference: Exact baseline A/B/C source spans, raw queries, full 8192 capacity, max cosine and source-hash ties
precision: FP16 CUDA inference; float32 normalized stored vectors
secondary_contrasts: C-B; exploratory intervals without multiplicity correction
test_use: Final evaluation only; overlap text audit with fixed quarantine permitted
ties: ascending SHA256 of exact full text; no pool-position/ID/gold features

training.checkpoint_selection: Highest validation NDCG@10 among trained checkpoints; tie earliest; official scores never select
training.dropout: Pretrained encoder dropout retained during training; all dropout disabled for validation and final inference
training.full_run_gate: Pilot best NDCG@10 >= frozen validation NDCG@10 minus 0.01 and finite/stable optimizer steps
training.negative_mix: Alternate train-only frozen-dense hard and deterministic random negatives, excluding every known positive
training.positive_selection: Train-only IDF-weighted lexical best of explicit source passages; no assumption all chunks positive
training.precision: FP16 frozen backbone and activations; FP32 adapters and AdamW moments; dynamic gradient scaling
training.scheduler: linear decay to zero over at most two eligible-query passes
training.smoke: 32 real eligible training queries, 64 updates, reset adapters and optimizer before main training
training.targets: All 24 encoder layers attention query/value projections; verified 48 modules
training.validation_representation: Fixed 128 training-derived heldout queries versus all heldout skills, first source passage <=384 tokens per skill; query <=256
